message: テスト虎の穴へようこそ

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was a fulfilling day. Once it's all over, tests might not be so bad after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No way! Isn't that enough already?! Let's just say it's over. I don't want to look at another textbook or notebook ever again.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady, I have come to pick you up.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lady Vice President. There is no need for concern.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady, please leave the last-minute test preparation and review to me, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I have devised a meticulous curriculum and will accompany you through the night without a single second to spare.」

name: Misa
message: 「Looks like things will be fine with him around」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, milady. Preparations for the Failing Grade Annihilation Project, 'Test Tiger's Den,' are complete.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, shall we head home too?」

name: Misa
message: 「I won't lose to you, Sakura-kun! Don't think I'm going to get all buddy-buddy with you!」
I'm so glad I became Student Council President…….
Being able to have a friendly study session like this feels like a dream.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. So this is what a sparkling school life is like, huh」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku…… Impressive as always, Lord Synn. Concealing your plot to turn the academy into a harem behind the image of a sparkling school life」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you always so eager to make me out to be evil?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I won't allow a scheme like that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukkukkuu. You're already in the palm of Lord Synn's hand just by joining this friendly study session, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, no harems! Rejected! Something that unwholesome is out of the question!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, I'm not doing that. I don't even want one」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha--!? Do you want me gone that badly?!」

name: Synn?
message: 「To put it bluntly, you're an eyesore」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy! Stop imitating my voice and saying weird stuff!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I was just voicing your inner thoughts for you」

name: Synn
message: 「I've never thought anything like that in my life」

name: Synn
message: 「I get it! You have some business with me, right? Could it be you want me to help out at the shop tomorrow?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if I'd ask that right before exams」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you looking around so restlessly for?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Nothing, I was just making sure nobody's around」

name: Synn
message: 「Would it be bad if someone was?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gonna snip off a piece of Lord Synn with those?! Hardcore, man」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sorry 'bout that, Soba. Thing is, a deadly weapon like that's a bit too hard for my limbs to handle」

name: Synn
message: 「Hitting people with shears is a bad idea」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Anyway, I'm giving these to you, so take 'em and get lost, you thief!」

name: Synn
message: 「My old ones were broken, so I'm really happy. Leave it to my childhood friend who knows everything about me」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I never expected to get a gift, so I'm kinda moved」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, that settles it! See ya!」
